Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner ignored clear sources showing Ghar Ki Rani is a 1940s film (Wikipedia: 1940; IMDb: 1945) and instead fabricated a “canonical” 2007 date from IMDb Release Info. This misapplied method led to the incorrect conclusion that Heaven Help Us (1985) was released first, when Ghar Ki Rani was released decades earlier.
